notes.title: Brigadoon Expansion
notes.content:
Hey everyone so after a nice break from major game design I am back and feeling fresh! I wanted to update y’all on what I want to do with Brigadoon and expand upon it even further with possible DLC and more ports to different devices plus a possible book series explaining Brigadoon’s past and more about the characters within the game! Here is the list of some that will be worked on but some are a maybe so no guarantees.

Mac
Xbox
IOS (Maybe)
Android (Maybe)
Nintendo Switch (Maybe)

Thank you to everyone who played and supported the game from the very beginning and even though not many people know about this game I still want to have fun expanding upon it! :)
